paper_title: Axion dark matter: strings and their cores
notes: Pure theory/numerical-simulation paper (Fleury & Moore) on axion cosmic string network density and its logarithmic dependence on the string separation-to-core ratio, aimed at the efficiency of axion dark matter production and hence the relation between f_a and the DM density. It reports no experimental/observational exclusion on any axion coupling, no measured limit curve, and no coupling-vs-mass sensitivity projection. Therefore is_new_limit=false and no data points.
